input.summary: Cap raised to 12 months' Fees and Excluded Claims placed outside the mutual cap
input.comment: [Playbook] A one-month cap applied "without exception" sits below our walk-away line and swallows the Excluded Claims defined in 21.3. We have moved the mutual cap to twelve months' Fees and carved Excluded Claims (indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct) out of it.

ops.oldText: 21.1 Each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the one month preceding the event, without exception.
ops.newText: 21.1 Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed Fees actually paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the event.
